# Pre-11B Lock Snapshots

These are unmodified `agent.lock` bytes produced by the installed Homebrew
AgentPM 0.1.36 CLI, whose released build predates 11B. They were captured on
2026-10-23 (America/Denver).
They were not generated by the code under test.

An isolated local HTTP fixture registry served one synthetic Tool archive.
The old CLI scaffolded an Agent and a Skill; both manifests passed `lint --strict`
against the checked-in schema before `install` created these v2/v3 locks.
No production endpoint, credentials or user project was used.

Keep the timestamps, hashes, field ordering, omitted fields and final newlines:
the fixtures verify byte compatibility, not merely JSON equivalence.
